//! Read-only NumPy views own an Arc snapshot; stepping requires exclusive ownership.
use nova_core::{Lineage, Particle};
use nova_physics::{Config, Universe};
use numpy::{ndarray::ArrayView2, PyArray2, PyArrayMethods};
use pyo3::{
    exceptions::{PyRuntimeError, PyValueError},
    prelude::*,
};
use std::sync::Arc;
fn value(e: impl std::fmt::Display) -> PyErr {
    PyValueError::new_err(e.to_string())
}
#[pyclass(name = "Universe")]
struct PyUniverse {
    inner: Arc<Universe>,
}
#[pyclass(frozen)]
struct Snapshot {
    inner: Arc<Universe>,
}
#[pymethods]
impl PyUniverse {
    #[new]
    #[pyo3(signature=(particles=4096,seed=42,preset="particle-life",enable_crossover=false,max_particles=262144))]
    fn new(
        particles: usize,
        seed: u64,
        preset: &str,
        enable_crossover: bool,
        max_particles: usize,
    ) -> PyResult<Self> {
        let mut config = Config {
            seed,
            max_particles,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        match preset {
            "particle-life" => (),
            "cosmic-ink" => config.curl = 0.4,
            "particle-vm" => {
                config.pvm = true;
                config.crossover = enable_crossover;
            }
            "liquid-mpm" => {
                config.mpm = true;
                config.dt = 0.001;
            }
            "hunar" | "realethersim" | "primordial-dish" | "par-particle-life" | "fusion"
            | "cellflow" => {
                config.fusion = Some(nova_physics::fusion_family(preset).map_err(value)?);
            }
            _ => {
                return Err(value(
                    "unknown preset; use a Nova preset or hunar, realethersim, primordial-dish, par-particle-life, cellflow, fusion",
                ))
            }
        }
        if enable_crossover && !config.pvm {
            return Err(value("crossover requires particle-vm"));
        }
        Ok(Self {
            inner: Arc::new(Universe::new(particles, config).map_err(value)?),
        })
    }
    fn step(&mut self, py: Python<'_>, ticks: usize) -> PyResult<()> {
        let u=Arc::get_mut(&mut self.inner).ok_or_else(||PyRuntimeError::new_err("release Snapshot and all its array/tensor views before stepping; views pin simulation memory"))?;
        py.allow_threads(|| u.step(ticks)).map_err(value)
    }
    fn snapshot(&self) -> Snapshot {
        Snapshot {
            inner: self.inner.clone(),
        }
    }
    #[getter]
    fn tick(&self) -> u64 {
        self.inner.tick
    }
    fn __len__(&self) -> usize {
        self.inner.particles.len()
    }
    fn set_affinities(&mut self, matrix: Vec<Vec<f32>>) -> PyResult<()> {
        if matrix.len() != 8
            || matrix
                .iter()
                .any(|r| r.len() != 8 || r.iter().any(|v| !v.is_finite() || v.abs() > 1.))
        {
            return Err(value("expected finite 8x8 matrix in [-1,1]"));
        }
        let u = Arc::get_mut(&mut self.inner)
            .ok_or_else(|| value("release all snapshots before mutation"))?;
        for (i, row) in matrix.iter().enumerate() {
            u.matrix[i].copy_from_slice(row);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn inject(
        &mut self,
        position: [f32; 3],
        velocity: [f32; 3],
        mass: f32,
        radius: f32,
        species: u32,
        genome: [u8; 16],
    ) -> PyResult<u64> {
        let u = Arc::get_mut(&mut self.inner)
            .ok_or_else(|| value("release all snapshots before mutation"))?;
        if u.config.mpm || u.fusion.is_some() {
            return Err(value("MPM/fusion membership is fixed for a run"));
        }
        if u.particles.len() >= u.config.max_particles {
            return Err(value("particle capacity exceeded"));
        }
        let p = Particle {
            pos_rad: [position[0], position[1], position[2], radius],
            vel_mass: [velocity[0], velocity[1], velocity[2], mass],
            phenotype: [species, 0, 0, 10000],
            genome_tape: genome,
        };
        u.particles
            .push(p, Lineage::new(&genome, vec![], 0, u.tick))
            .map_err(value)
    }
}
#[pymethods]
impl Snapshot {
    #[getter]
    fn tick(&self) -> u64 {
        self.inner.tick
    }
    #[getter]
    fn positions<'py>(this: Bound<'py, Self>) -> Bound<'py, PyArray2<f32>> {
        let (ptr, n) = {
            let owner = this.borrow();
            (
                owner.inner.particles.positions.as_ptr().cast::<f32>(),
                owner.inner.particles.len(),
            )
        };
        // SAFETY: Float4 is contiguous 16-byte POD with no padding. Snapshot owns
        // the Arc; Universe cannot mutate/reallocate while any snapshot exists.
        let view = unsafe { ArrayView2::from_shape_ptr((n, 4), ptr) };
        let array = unsafe { PyArray2::borrow_from_array(&view, this.into_any()) };
        array.readwrite().make_nonwriteable();
        array
    }
    #[getter]
    fn velocities<'py>(this: Bound<'py, Self>) -> Bound<'py, PyArray2<f32>> {
        let (ptr, n) = {
            let owner = this.borrow();
            (
                owner.inner.particles.velocities.as_ptr().cast::<f32>(),
                owner.inner.particles.len(),
            )
        };
        let view = unsafe { ArrayView2::from_shape_ptr((n, 4), ptr) };
        let array = unsafe { PyArray2::borrow_from_array(&view, this.into_any()) };
        array.readwrite().make_nonwriteable();
        array
    }
    #[getter]
    fn genomes<'py>(this: Bound<'py, Self>) -> Bound<'py, PyArray2<u8>> {
        let (ptr, n) = {
            let owner = this.borrow();
            (
                owner.inner.particles.genomes.as_ptr().cast::<u8>(),
                owner.inner.particles.len(),
            )
        };
        let view = unsafe { ArrayView2::from_shape_ptr((n, 16), ptr) };
        let array = unsafe { PyArray2::borrow_from_array(&view, this.into_any()) };
        array.readwrite().make_nonwriteable();
        array
    }
}
#[pyclass(name = "Conway")]
struct PyConway {
    inner: nova_physics::conway::Conway,
}
#[pymethods]
impl PyConway {
    #[new]
    #[pyo3(signature=(width=2048,height=2048,rule="B3/S23",seed=42))]
    fn new(width: usize, height: usize, rule: &str, seed: u64) -> PyResult<Self> {
        Ok(Self {
            inner: nova_physics::conway::Conway::new(
                width,
                height,
                nova_physics::conway::Rule::parse(rule).map_err(value)?,
                seed,
            )
            .map_err(value)?,
        })
    }
    fn step(&mut self, py: Python<'_>, ticks: usize) -> PyResult<()> {
        if ticks > 1_000_000 {
            return Err(value("tick budget exceeded"));
        }
        py.allow_threads(|| {
            for _ in 0..ticks {
                self.inner.step()
            }
        });
        Ok(())
    }
    #[getter]
    fn population(&self) -> u64 {
        self.inner.population()
    }
    fn words(&self) -> Vec<u64> {
        self.inner.words.clone()
    }
}
#[pymodule]
fn _native(m: &Bound<'_, PyModule>) -> PyResult<()> {
    m.add_class::<PyUniverse>()?;
    m.add_class::<Snapshot>()?;
    m.add_class::<PyConway>()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn main() {
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir("shaders").expect("shaders directory") {
        let p = entry.unwrap().path();
        if p.extension().and_then(|x| x.to_str()) != Some("wgsl") {
            continue;
        }
        println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", p.display());
        let source = std::fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap();
        let module = naga::front::wgsl::parse_str(&source)
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {}", p.display(), e.emit_to_string(&source)));
        naga::valid::Validator::new(
            naga::valid::ValidationFlags::all(),
            naga::valid::Capabilities::empty(),
        )
        .validate(&module)
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {:?}", p.display(), e));
    }
}

// Separable bilateral depth + guided pigment/thickness smoothing.
struct Filter {
    axis:vec4<i32>,values:vec4<f32>
}
@group(0) @binding(0) var depth:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var pigment:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var output_depth:texture_storage_2d<r32float,write>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var output_pigment:texture_storage_2d<rgba16float,write>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<uniform> cfg:Filter;
@compute @workgroup_size(8,8)
fn bilateral_main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id:vec3<u32>){
    let p=vec2<i32>(id.xy);
    let size=vec2<i32>(textureDimensions(depth));
    if(any(p>=size)){
        return;
    }
    let center=textureLoad(depth,p,0).r;
    if(center>=9.99){
        textureStore(output_depth,p,vec4(10.));
        textureStore(output_pigment,p,vec4(0.));
        return;
    }
    var sum=0.;
    var z=0.;
    var color=vec4(0.);
    for(var k=-8;k<=8;k++){
        if(abs(k)>cfg.axis.z){
            continue;
        }
        let q=clamp(p+cfg.axis.xy*k,vec2(0),size-1);
        let d=textureLoad(depth,q,0).r;
        if(d>=9.99){
            continue;
        }
        let spatial=exp(-.5*f32(k*k)/cfg.values.x);
        let range=exp(-.5*(d-center)*(d-center)/cfg.values.y);
        let w=spatial*range;
        sum+=w;
        z+=w*d;
        color+=w*textureLoad(pigment,q,0);
    }
    textureStore(output_depth,p,vec4(z/max(sum,1e-8)));
    textureStore(output_pigment,p,color/max(sum,1e-8));
}

// GGX surface, Beer-Lambert thickness, approximate SSS/HG and thin-film tint.
struct Camera {
    eye:vec4<f32>,right:vec4<f32>,up:vec4<f32>,forward:vec4<f32>,view:vec4<f32>,material:vec4<f32>,light:vec4<f32>,post:vec4<f32>
}
@group(0) @binding(0) var depth:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var pigment:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> cam:Camera;
struct Quad {
    @builtin(position) pos:vec4<f32>,@location(0) uv:vec2<f32>
}
@vertex fn fullscreen(@builtin(vertex_index) i:u32)->Quad{
    var p=array<vec2<f32>,3>(vec2(-1.,-1.),vec2(3.,-1.),vec2(-1.,3.));
    var out:Quad;
    out.pos=vec4(p[i],0.,1.);
    out.uv=p[i]*vec2(.5,-.5)+.5;
    return out;
}
fn ray(p:vec2<f32>)->vec3<f32>{
    let uv=(p/cam.view.xy*2.-1.)*vec2(1.,-1.);
    return normalize(cam.forward.xyz+cam.right.xyz*uv.x*cam.forward.w*cam.view.x/cam.view.y+cam.up.xyz*uv.y*cam.forward.w);
}
fn position(p:vec2<i32>,fallback:f32)->vec3<f32>{
    let size=vec2<i32>(textureDimensions(depth));
    let q=clamp(p,vec2(0),size-1);
    var z=textureLoad(depth,q,0).r;
    if(z>=9.99){
        z=fallback;
    }
    let r=ray(vec2<f32>(q)+.5);
    return cam.eye.xyz+r*z/max(dot(r,cam.forward.xyz),.01);
}
fn environment(r:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32>{
    let ceiling=pow(max(r.y,0.),5.);
    let panel=pow(max(dot(r,normalize(vec3(-.5,.7,.4))),0.),45.);
    return mix(vec3(.012,.018,.035),vec3(.15,.19,.25),r.y*.5+.5)+vec3(.9,.8,.7)*ceiling+vec3(5.,5.5,6.)*panel;
}
fn phase(cosine:f32,g:f32)->f32{
    return (1.-g*g)/(12.5663706*pow(max(1.+g*g-2.*g*cosine,.001),1.5));
}
fn brdf(n:vec3<f32>,v:vec3<f32>,l:vec3<f32>,albedo:vec3<f32>,F0:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32>{
    let h=normalize(v+l);
    let nl=max(dot(n,l),0.);
    let nv=max(dot(n,v),.001);
    let nh=max(dot(n,h),0.);
    let vh=max(dot(v,h),0.);
    let a=max(.025,cam.material.x*cam.material.x);
    let a2=a*a;
    let denom=nh*nh*(a2-1.)+1.;
    let D=a2/(3.14159265*denom*denom);
    let k=(cam.material.x+1.)*(cam.material.x+1.)/8.;
    let G=nv/(nv*(1.-k)+k)*nl/max(nl*(1.-k)+k,.001);
    let F=F0+(1.-F0)*pow(1.-vh,5.);
    return ((1.-F)*albedo/3.14159265+D*G*F/max(4.*nl*nv,.001))*nl;
}
@fragment fn shade(in:Quad)->@location(0) vec4<f32>{
    let pixel=vec2<i32>(in.pos.xy);
    let z=textureLoad(depth,pixel,0).r;
    let r=ray(in.pos.xy);
    let background=environment(r)*.12+vec3(.008,.006,.018);
    if(z>=9.99){
        return vec4(background,1.);
    }
    let p=position(pixel,z);
    let xp=position(pixel+vec2(1,0),z)-p;
    let xm=p-position(pixel-vec2(1,0),z);
    let yp=position(pixel+vec2(0,1),z)-p;
    let ym=p-position(pixel-vec2(0,1),z);
    let dx=select(xm,xp,abs(dot(xp,cam.forward.xyz))<abs(dot(xm,cam.forward.xyz)));
    let dy=select(ym,yp,abs(dot(yp,cam.forward.xyz))<abs(dot(ym,cam.forward.xyz)));
    var n=normalize(cross(dx,dy)+vec3(1e-8));
    let v=normalize(cam.eye.xyz-p);
    if(dot(n,v)<0.){
        n=-n;
    }
    let raw=textureLoad(pigment,pixel,0);
    let thickness=clamp(raw.a,0.,4.);
    let albedo=clamp(raw.rgb/max(raw.a,.00001),vec3(.015),vec3(.98));
    let sigma=-log(albedo)*cam.material.y;
    let trans=exp(-sigma*thickness);
    let nv=max(dot(n,v),0.);
    let wavelength=vec3(650.,510.,475.);
    let film=.5+.5*cos(12.5663706*1.33*cam.material.w*max(.2,nv)/wavelength);
    let F0=mix(vec3(.04),vec3(.04)+.18*film,cam.light.w);
    var color=vec3(0.);
    let l1=normalize(vec3(-.6,.9,.8));
    let l2=normalize(vec3(.8,.1,-.6));
    let l3=normalize(vec3(-.4,-.5,-.8));
    color+=brdf(n,v,l1,albedo,F0)*vec3(4.,3.8,3.5);
    color+=brdf(n,v,l2,albedo,F0)*vec3(1.1,1.5,2.4);
    color+=brdf(n,v,l3,albedo,F0)*vec3(1.8,.6,1.2);
    let reflection=reflect(-v,n);
    let F=F0+(1.-F0)*pow(1.-nv,5.);
    color+=environment(reflection)*F;
    let back=pow(max(dot(-n,l2),0.),2.)+phase(dot(-v,l2),cam.light.z)*2.;
    color+=cam.material.z*(1.-trans)*albedo*(.4+back)*vec3(.9,1.1,1.5);
    let bend=r+(.18*(1.-trans.r))*n;
    let behind=environment(normalize(bend))*.2;
    color+=trans*behind*(1.-F);
    color+=.02*albedo*pow(1.-nv,3.);
    return vec4(max(color,vec3(0.)),1.);
}

// Bounded image-space lens/bloom; ACES fitted display curve, not full ACES OCIO.
struct Post {
    view:vec4<f32>,lens:vec4<f32>,style:vec4<f32>
}
@group(0) @binding(0) var hdr:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var depth:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var linear:sampler;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<uniform> cfg:Post;
struct Quad {
    @builtin(position) pos:vec4<f32>,@location(0) uv:vec2<f32>
}
@vertex fn fullscreen(@builtin(vertex_index) i:u32)->Quad{
    var p=array<vec2<f32>,3>(vec2(-1.,-1.),vec2(3.,-1.),vec2(-1.,3.));
    var out:Quad;
    out.pos=vec4(p[i],0.,1.);
    out.uv=p[i]*vec2(.5,-.5)+.5;
    return out;
}
fn aces(x:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32>{
    return clamp((x*(2.51*x+.03))/(x*(2.43*x+.59)+.14),vec3(0.),vec3(1.));
}
@fragment fn post(in:Quad)->@location(0) vec4<f32>{
    let uv=in.uv;
    let size=cfg.view.xy;
    let z=textureLoad(depth,vec2<i32>(clamp(in.pos.xy,vec2(0.),size-1.)),0).r;
    let coc=min(12.,cfg.lens.y*abs(z-cfg.lens.x)/max(z,.1));
    var color=textureSampleLevel(hdr,linear,uv,0.).rgb;
    var weight=1.;
    var bloom=vec3(0.);
    for(var i=0;i<16;i++){
        let a=f32(i)*2.399963;
        let radius=sqrt((f32(i)+.5)/16.);
        let direction=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));
        let aperture=direction*radius*coc/size;
        let sample=textureSampleLevel(hdr,linear,clamp(uv+aperture,vec2(0.),vec2(1.)),0.).rgb;
        if(coc>.5){
            color+=sample;
            weight+=1.;
        }
        let light=textureSampleLevel(hdr,linear,clamp(uv+direction*radius*24./size,vec2(0.),vec2(1.)),0.).rgb;
        bloom+=max(light-vec3(1.),vec3(0.))/16.;
    }
    color=color/weight+cfg.lens.z*bloom;
    let vignette=1.-cfg.style.x*dot(uv-.5,uv-.5);
    let noise=fract(sin(dot(in.pos.xy,vec2(12.9898,78.233))+cfg.view.z*.13)*43758.5453)-.5;
    let linear_color=aces(color*cfg.lens.w);
    let mapped=select(pow(linear_color,vec3(1./2.2)),linear_color,cfg.style.z>0.5)*vignette+noise*cfg.style.y;
    return vec4(clamp(mapped,vec3(0.),vec3(1.)),1.);
}

// Surface splats: sphere depth and additive pigment optical thickness.
struct Particle {
    p:vec4<f32>,v:vec4<f32>,previous:vec4<f32>
}
struct Camera {
    eye:vec4<f32>,right:vec4<f32>,up:vec4<f32>,forward:vec4<f32>,view:vec4<f32>,material:vec4<f32>,light:vec4<f32>,post:vec4<f32>
}
@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage,read> particles:array<Particle>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> cam:Camera;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage,read> palette:array<vec4<f32>>;
struct Vertex {
    @builtin(position) position:vec4<f32>,@location(0) uv:vec2<f32>,@location(1) @interpolate(flat) depth:f32,@location(2) @interpolate(flat) pigment:vec3<f32>
}
@vertex fn splat(@builtin(vertex_index) vi:u32,@builtin(instance_index) pi:u32)->Vertex{
    var corners=array<vec2<f32>,6>(vec2(-1.,-1.),vec2(1.,-1.),vec2(-1.,1.),vec2(-1.,1.),vec2(1.,-1.),vec2(1.,1.));
    let p=particles[pi];
    let corner=corners[vi];
    let radius=cam.view.z;
    let local=p.p.xyz-cam.eye.xyz;
    let z=dot(local,cam.forward.xyz);
    let x=dot(local,cam.right.xyz)+corner.x*radius;
    let y=dot(local,cam.up.xyz)+corner.y*radius;
    let near=.05;
    let far=10.;
    var out:Vertex;
    out.position=vec4(x/(cam.forward.w*cam.view.x/cam.view.y),y/cam.forward.w,far/(far-near)*z-far*near/(far-near),z);
    out.uv=corner;
    out.depth=z;
    out.pigment=palette[u32(p.p.w)].rgb;
    return out;
}
struct DepthOut {
    @location(0) depth:f32,@builtin(frag_depth) hardware:f32
}
@fragment fn sphere_depth(in:Vertex)->DepthOut{
    let q=dot(in.uv,in.uv);
    if(q>=1.||in.depth<.06){
        discard;
    }
    let z=max(.051,in.depth-cam.view.z*sqrt(1.-q));
    var out:DepthOut;
    out.depth=z;
    out.hardware=10./9.95-.5/(9.95*z);
    return out;
}
@fragment fn optical_thickness(in:Vertex)->@location(0) vec4<f32>{
    let q=dot(in.uv,in.uv);
    if(q>=1.||in.depth<.06){
        discard;
    }
    let thickness=2.*cam.view.z*sqrt(1.-q);
    return vec4(in.pigment*thickness,thickness);
}

//! Native controls inspired by SandboxScience's separation of simulation, rules and presentation.
//! Original egui implementation; no Vue/browser code is executed or copied.
use anyhow::Result;
use nova_fusion::{breeding::Candidate, Family, Model};
use nova_physics::Universe;
use winit::{event::WindowEvent, window::Window};
pub struct Presentation {
    pub radius: f32,
    pub roughness: f32,
    pub exposure: f32,
}
pub struct Panel {
    pub single_step: bool,
    context: egui::Context,
    state: egui_winit::State,
    renderer: egui_wgpu::Renderer,
    pub presentation: Presentation,
    rule: usize,
    pattern: usize,
    palette: usize,
    children: Vec<Candidate>,
    message: String,
}
pub struct Prepared {
    pub jobs: Vec<egui::ClippedPrimitive>,
    pub screen: egui_wgpu::ScreenDescriptor,
    pub commands: Vec<wgpu::CommandBuffer>,
    free: Vec<egui::TextureId>,
}
enum Action {
    Family(Family),
    Mutate,
    Random,
    Breed,
    Choose(usize),
    Preset(&'static str),
    Generate,
    Save,
    Step,
}
impl Panel {
    pub fn new(window: &Window, device: &wgpu::Device, format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let context = egui::Context::default();
        let mut style = (*context.style()).clone();
        style.visuals = egui::Visuals::dark();
        style.visuals.panel_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(15, 21, 32);
        style.visuals.window_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(20, 28, 42);
        style.visuals.selection.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(25, 116, 135);
        style.spacing.item_spacing = egui::vec2(8., 8.);
        context.set_style(style);
        let state = egui_winit::State::new(
            context.clone(),
            egui::ViewportId::ROOT,
            window,
            Some(window.scale_factor() as f32),
            None,
        );
        Self {
            single_step: false,
            context,
            state,
            renderer: egui_wgpu::Renderer::new(device, format, None, 1),
            presentation: Presentation {
                radius: 0.025,
                roughness: 0.18,
                exposure: 1.,
            },
            rule: 0,
            pattern: 0,
            palette: 0,
            children: vec![],
            message: String::new(),
        }
    }
    pub fn on_event(&mut self, window: &Window, event: &WindowEvent) -> bool {
        self.state.on_window_event(window, event).consumed
    }
    pub fn frame(
        &mut self,
        window: &Window,
        u: &mut Universe,
        paused: &mut bool,
    ) -> egui::FullOutput {
        let input = self.state.take_egui_input(window);
        let ctx = self.context.clone();
        let mut actions = vec![];
        let output = ctx.run(input, |ctx| {
            egui::TopBottomPanel::top("nova-toolbar").show(ctx, |ui| {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.heading(
                        egui::RichText::new("NOVA / LAB")
                            .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(104, 221, 235)),
                    );
                    ui.separator();
                    if ui
                        .button(if *paused {
                            "▶ Executar"
                        } else {
                            "Ⅱ Pausar"
                        })
                        .clicked()
                    {
                        *paused = !*paused;
                    }
                    if ui
                        .add_enabled(*paused, egui::Button::new("Passo"))
                        .clicked()
                    {
                        actions.push(Action::Step);
                    }
                    ui.separator();
                    ui.label(format!("{} partículas", u.particles.len()));
                    ui.label(format!("Geração {}", u.tick));
                });
            });
            egui::SidePanel::right("nova-inspector")
                .default_width(320.)
                .min_width(270.)
                .show(ctx, |ui| {
                    egui::ScrollArea::vertical().show(ui, |ui| {
                        ui.heading("Simulação");
                        if let Some(model) = &mut u.fusion {
                            let current = model.settings.family;
                            let mut chosen = current;
                            egui::ComboBox::from_id_source("source")
                                .selected_text(format!("{current:?}"))
                                .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                    for (label, family) in [
                                        ("Nova Fusion", Family::Fusion),
                                        ("Hunar", Family::Hunar),
                                        ("Ethersim", Family::Realethersim),
                                        ("Primordial Dish", Family::PrimordialDish),
                                        ("PAR Particle Life", Family::ParParticleLife),
                                        ("CellFlow", Family::CellFlow),
                                    ] {
                                        ui.selectable_value(&mut chosen, family, label);
                                    }
                                });
                            if chosen != current {
                                actions.push(Action::Family(chosen));
                            }
                            ui.label(format!(
                                "{}D · {} espécies",
                                model.settings.dimensions, model.settings.species
                            ));
                            let s = &mut model.settings;
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut s.force, 0.0..=1000.0)
                                    .logarithmic(true)
                                    .text("Força"),
                            );
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut s.retention, 0.0..=1.0)
                                    .text("Retenção de velocidade"),
                            );
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut s.dt, 0.0001..=1.0)
                                    .logarithmic(true)
                                    .text("Passo de tempo"),
                            );
                            u.config.dt = s.dt;
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut s.velocity_coupling, 0.0..=2.0)
                                    .text("Alinhamento"),
                            );
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut s.temperature, 0.0..=4.0).text("Agitação"),
                            );
                            if s.family == Family::CellFlow {
                                ui.collapsing("Resposta à densidade", |ui| {
                                    ui.add(
                                        egui::Slider::new(&mut s.cell.balance, 0.0..=1.0)
                                            .text("Equilíbrio"),
                                    );
                                    ui.add(
                                        egui::Slider::new(
                                            &mut s.cell.expected_neighbors,
                                            1.0..=256.0,
                                        )
                                        .text("Vizinhos de referência"),
                                    );
                                    ui.add(
                                        egui::Slider::new(&mut s.cell.repulsion, 0.0..=100.0)
                                            .text("Repulsão"),
                                    );
                                    ui.add(
                                        egui::Slider::new(&mut s.cell.attraction, 0.0..=4.0)
                                            .text("Atração"),
                                    );
                                });
                            }
                            ui.collapsing("Regras variáveis", |ui| {
                                ui.checkbox(&mut s.variation.enabled, "Variar no tempo");
                                ui.add(
                                    egui::Slider::new(&mut s.variation.amplitude, 0.0..=1.0)
                                        .text("Amplitude"),
                                );
                                ui.add(
                                    egui::Slider::new(&mut s.variation.speed, 0.0..=2.0)
                                        .text("Ritmo"),
                                );
                            });
                            ui.separator();
                            ui.heading("Presets e evolução");
                            ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
                                for name in ["genesis", "orbs", "garden", "symbiotes", "polymers"] {
                                    if ui.button(name).clicked() {
                                        actions.push(Action::Preset(name));
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                                if ui.button("Mutar").clicked() {
                                    actions.push(Action::Mutate);
                                }
                                if ui.button("Aleatorizar").clicked() {
                                    actions.push(Action::Random);
                                }
                                if ui.button("Reproduzir").clicked() {
                                    actions.push(Action::Breed);
                                }
                            });
                            for (i, child) in self.children.iter().enumerate() {
                                if ui
                                    .button(format!("{} · {}", i + 1, child.lineage.operator))
                                    .clicked()
                                {
                                    actions.push(Action::Choose(i));
                                }
                            }
                            ui.collapsing("Geradores", |ui| {
                                use nova_fusion::par::generators::{
                                    colors::PaletteType, positions::PositionPattern,
                                    rules::RuleType,
                                };
                                egui::ComboBox::from_label("Regra")
                                    .selected_text(RuleType::all()[self.rule].display_name())
                                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                        for (i, x) in RuleType::all().iter().enumerate() {
                                            ui.selectable_value(
                                                &mut self.rule,
                                                i,
                                                x.display_name(),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    });
                                egui::ComboBox::from_label("Distribuição")
                                    .selected_text(
                                        PositionPattern::all()[self.pattern].display_name(),
                                    )
                                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                        for (i, x) in PositionPattern::all().iter().enumerate() {
                                            ui.selectable_value(
                                                &mut self.pattern,
                                                i,
                                                x.display_name(),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    });
                                egui::ComboBox::from_label("Paleta")
                                    .selected_text(PaletteType::all()[self.palette].display_name())
                                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                        for (i, x) in PaletteType::all().iter().enumerate() {
                                            ui.selectable_value(
                                                &mut self.palette,
                                                i,
                                                x.display_name(),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    });
                                if ui.button("Aplicar e redistribuir partículas").clicked() {
                                    actions.push(Action::Generate);
                                }
                            });
                            if ui.button("Salvar preset").clicked() {
                                actions.push(Action::Save);
                            }
                            ui.separator();
                            ui.heading("Matriz de interação");
                            ui.small("Linha recebe · coluna influencia · + atrai · − repele");
                            let k = model.settings.species;
                            egui::Grid::new("affinities")
                                .spacing([2., 2.])
                                .show(ui, |ui| {
                                    for i in 0..k {
                                        for j in 0..k {
                                            ui.add_sized(
                                                [35., 22.],
                                                egui::DragValue::new(&mut u.matrix[i][j])
                                                    .speed(0.02)
                                                    .clamp_range(-1.0..=1.0)
                                                    .fixed_decimals(2),
                                            );
                                        }
                                        ui.end_row();
                                    }
                                });
                            ui.collapsing("Cores das espécies", |ui| {
                                for (i, color) in model.palette.iter_mut().take(k).enumerate() {
                                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                                        ui.label(format!("{}", i + 1));
                                        ui.color_edit_button_rgba_unmultiplied(color);
                                    });
                                }
                            });
                        } else {
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut u.config.strength, 0.0..=30.0).text("Força"),
                            );
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut u.config.damping, 0.0..=20.0)
                                    .text("Arrasto"),
                            );
                        }
                        ui.separator();
                        ui.collapsing("Aparência", |ui| {
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut self.presentation.radius, 0.002..=0.08)
                                    .text("Raio visual"),
                            );
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut self.presentation.roughness, 0.03..=0.8)
                                    .text("Rugosidade"),
                            );
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Slider::new(&mut self.presentation.exposure, 0.1..=3.0)
                                    .text("Exposição"),
                            );
                        });
                        ui.small(
                            "Setas: orbitar · roda: zoom · clique esquerdo/direito: atrair/repelir",
                        );
                        if !self.message.is_empty() {
                            ui.separator();
                            ui.label(&self.message);
                        }
                    });
                });
        });
        for action in actions {
            if let Err(e) = self.apply(action, u) {
                self.message = format!("{e:#}");
            }
        }
        self.state
            .handle_platform_output(window, output.platform_output.clone());
        output
    }
    fn apply(&mut self, action: Action, u: &mut Universe) -> Result<()> {
        match action {
            Action::Step => self.single_step = true,
            Action::Breed => self.children = u.breed_rules()?,
            Action::Choose(i) => {
                u.choose_rules(&self.children[i])?;
                self.children.clear();
            }
            Action::Mutate | Action::Random => {
                let choices = u.breed_rules()?;
                let i = if matches!(action, Action::Random) {
                    5
                } else {
                    2
                };
                u.choose_rules(&choices[i])?;
            }
            Action::Family(f) => {
                let mut model = Model::new(f);
                model.initialize(&mut u.particles, &mut u.matrix, u.config.seed)?;
                u.config.fusion = Some(f);
                u.config.dt = model.settings.dt;
                u.fusion = Some(model);
                self.children.clear();
            }
            Action::Preset(name) => {
                u.fusion
                    .as_mut()
                    .unwrap()
                    .apply_preset(&mut u.particles, &mut u.matrix, name)?;
            }
            Action::Generate => {
                u.fusion.as_mut().unwrap().select_generators(
                    &mut u.particles,
                    &mut u.matrix,
                    self.rule,
                    self.pattern,
                    self.palette,
                )?;
            }
            Action::Save => {
                let model = u.fusion.as_ref().unwrap();
                std::fs::create_dir_all("runs")?;
                let path = format!(
                    "runs/fusion-preset-{}-{}.json",
                    u.tick,
                    std::time::SystemTime::now()
                        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)?
                        .as_nanos()
                );
                let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                    .write(true)
                    .create_new(true)
                    .open(&path)?;
                serde_json::to_writer_pretty(
                    file,
                    &nova_fusion::SavedPreset::capture(model, u.matrix),
                )?;
                self.message = format!("Preset salvo: {path}");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn prepare(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        output: egui::FullOutput,
        size: [u32; 2],
    ) -> Prepared {
        for (id, delta) in &output.textures_delta.set {
            self.renderer.update_texture(device, queue, *id, delta);
        }
        let jobs = self
            .context
            .tessellate(output.shapes, output.pixels_per_point);
        let screen = egui_wgpu::ScreenDescriptor {
            size_in_pixels: size,
            pixels_per_point: output.pixels_per_point,
        };
        let commands = self
            .renderer
            .update_buffers(device, queue, encoder, &jobs, &screen);
        Prepared {
            jobs,
            screen,
            commands,
            free: output.textures_delta.free,
        }
    }
    pub fn paint<'a>(&'a self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>, prepared: &'a Prepared) {
        self.renderer.render(pass, &prepared.jobs, &prepared.screen);
    }
    pub fn finish(&mut self, prepared: &Prepared) {
        for id in &prepared.free {
            self.renderer.free_texture(id);
        }
    }
}

mod controls;
// Native winit/wgpu fluid surface renderer; all shader assets embedded.
use anyhow::{ensure, Result};
use nova_physics::Universe;
use nova_storage::Lake;
use std::{
    cell::RefCell,
    path::PathBuf,
    rc::Rc,
    sync::Arc,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;
use winit::{
    event::{ElementState, Event, MouseScrollDelta, WindowEvent},
    event_loop::{ControlFlow, EventLoop},
    keyboard::{KeyCode, PhysicalKey},
    window::{Window, WindowBuilder},
};
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
struct RenderParticle {
    p: [f32; 4],
    v: [f32; 4],
    previous: [f32; 4],
}
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
struct Filter {
    axis: [i32; 4],
    values: [f32; 4],
}
struct Targets {
    depth: Vec<wgpu::TextureView>,
    pigment: Vec<wgpu::TextureView>,
    hardware: wgpu::TextureView,
    hdr: wgpu::TextureView,
    filters: Vec<wgpu::BindGroup>,
    lighting: wgpu::BindGroup,
    post: wgpu::BindGroup,
}
struct Renderer {
    ui: controls::Panel,
    window: Arc<Window>,
    surface: wgpu::Surface<'static>,
    device: wgpu::Device,
    queue: wgpu::Queue,
    config: wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
    particles: wgpu::Buffer,
    camera: wgpu::Buffer,
    post_config: wgpu::Buffer,
    _palette: wgpu::Buffer,
    sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
    filter_configs: [wgpu::Buffer; 2],
    depth_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pigment_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    filter_pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    light_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    post_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    splats: wgpu::BindGroup,
    targets: Option<Targets>,
    yaw: f32,
    pitch: f32,
    distance: f32,
    scene_scale: f32,
    capacity: usize,
}
fn buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, data: &[u8], usage: wgpu::BufferUsages) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
        label: None,
        contents: data,
        usage,
    })
}
fn entry(
    binding: u32,
    ty: wgpu::BindingType,
    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages,
) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility,
        ty,
        count: None,
    }
}
fn uniform() -> wgpu::BindingType {
    wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
        has_dynamic_offset: false,
        min_binding_size: None,
    }
}
fn texture(filterable: bool) -> wgpu::BindingType {
    wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable },
        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
        multisampled: false,
    }
}
fn layout(device: &wgpu::Device, entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry]) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
    device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
        label: None,
        entries,
    })
}
fn group(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    resources: &[wgpu::BindingResource<'_>],
) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
    device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
        label: None,
        layout,
        entries: &resources
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, r)| wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: i as u32,
                resource: r.clone(),
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    })
}
fn render_pipeline(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    shader: &wgpu::ShaderModule,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    vertex: &str,
    fragment: &str,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    blend: Option<wgpu::BlendState>,
    depth: bool,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: None,
        bind_group_layouts: &[layout],
        push_constant_ranges: &[],
    });
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: None,
        layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: shader,
            entry_point: vertex,
            buffers: &[],
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: shader,
            entry_point: fragment,
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format,
                blend,
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState::default(),
        depth_stencil: depth.then_some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
            depth_write_enabled: true,
            depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::Less,
            stencil: Default::default(),
            bias: Default::default(),
        }),
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview: None,
    })
}
impl Renderer {
    async fn new(window: Arc<Window>, capacity: usize) -> Result<Self> {
        let instance = wgpu::Instance::default();
        let surface = instance.create_surface(window.clone())?;
        let adapter = instance
            .request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
                power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::HighPerformance,
                compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
                force_fallback_adapter: false,
            })
            .await
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("no graphics adapter for native window"))?;
        ensure!(
            capacity * std::mem::size_of::<RenderParticle>()
                <= adapter.limits().max_storage_buffer_binding_size as usize,
            "particle render buffer exceeds adapter capacity"
        );
        let (device, queue) = adapter
            .request_device(
                &wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
                    label: Some("NOVA liquid"),
                    required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
                    required_limits: adapter.limits(),
                },
                None,
            )
            .await?;
        let size = window.inner_size();
        let caps = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
        let format = caps
            .formats
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .find(|f| !f.is_srgb())
            .unwrap_or(caps.formats[0]);
        let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
            format,
            width: size.width.max(1),
            height: size.height.max(1),
            present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode::Fifo,
            alpha_mode: caps.alpha_modes[0],
            view_formats: vec![],
            desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
        };
        surface.configure(&device, &config);
        let camera = buffer(
            &device,
            &[0u8; 128],
            wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        );
        let post_config = buffer(
            &device,
            &[0u8; 48],
            wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        );
        let colors: [[f32; 4]; 8] = [
            [0.03, 0.5, 0.9, 1.],
            [0.8, 0.05, 0.3, 1.],
            [0.4, 0.05, 0.9, 1.],
            [0.02, 0.8, 0.65, 1.],
            [0.9, 0.45, 0.03, 1.],
            [0.1, 0.2, 0.9, 1.],
            [0.9, 0.1, 0.6, 1.],
            [0.5, 0.9, 0.1, 1.],
        ];
        let palette = buffer(
            &device,
            bytemuck::cast_slice(&colors),
            wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        );
        let particles = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("presentation particles"),
            size: (capacity * 48) as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let shader = |name, source: &'static str| {
            device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
                label: Some(name),
                source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(source.into()),
            })
        };
        let splat_shader = shader(
            "sphere depth",
            include_str!("../shaders/fluid_surface.wgsl"),
        );
        let filter_shader = shader("bilateral", include_str!("../shaders/fluid_filter.wgsl"));
        let light_shader = shader(
            "liquid optics",
            include_str!("../shaders/fluid_lighting.wgsl"),
        );
        let post_shader = shader("post", include_str!("../shaders/fluid_post.wgsl"));
        use wgpu::ShaderStages as S;
        let storage = wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        };
        let splat_layout = layout(
            &device,
            &[
                entry(0, storage, S::VERTEX),
                entry(1, uniform(), S::VERTEX_FRAGMENT),
                entry(2, storage, S::VERTEX),
            ],
        );
        let depth_pipeline = render_pipeline(
            &device,
            &splat_shader,
            &splat_layout,
            "splat",
            "sphere_depth",
            wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float,
            None,
            true,
        );
        let additive = wgpu::BlendComponent {
            src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
            dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
            operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
        };
        let pigment_pipeline = render_pipeline(
            &device,
            &splat_shader,
            &splat_layout,
            "splat",
            "optical_thickness",
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            Some(wgpu::BlendState {
                color: additive,
                alpha: additive,
            }),
            false,
        );
        let splats = group(
            &device,
            &splat_layout,
            &[
                particles.as_entire_binding(),
                camera.as_entire_binding(),
                palette.as_entire_binding(),
            ],
        );
        let output = |format| wgpu::BindingType::StorageTexture {
            access: wgpu::StorageTextureAccess::WriteOnly,
            format,
            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
        };
        let filter_layout = layout(
            &device,
            &[
                entry(0, texture(false), S::COMPUTE),
                entry(1, texture(false), S::COMPUTE),
                entry(2, output(wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float), S::COMPUTE),
                entry(3, output(wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float), S::COMPUTE),
                entry(4, uniform(), S::COMPUTE),
            ],
        );
        let pl = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: None,
            bind_group_layouts: &[&filter_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });
        let filter_pipeline = device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: None,
            layout: Some(&pl),
            module: &filter_shader,
            entry_point: "bilateral_main",
        });
        let light_layout = layout(
            &device,
            &[
                entry(0, texture(false), S::FRAGMENT),
                entry(1, texture(false), S::FRAGMENT),
                entry(2, uniform(), S::FRAGMENT),
            ],
        );
        let light_pipeline = render_pipeline(
            &device,
            &light_shader,
            &light_layout,
            "fullscreen",
            "shade",
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            None,
            false,
        );
        let post_layout = layout(
            &device,
            &[
                entry(0, texture(true), S::FRAGMENT),
                entry(1, texture(false), S::FRAGMENT),
                entry(
                    2,
                    wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    S::FRAGMENT,
                ),
                entry(3, uniform(), S::FRAGMENT),
            ],
        );
        let post_pipeline = render_pipeline(
            &device,
            &post_shader,
            &post_layout,
            "fullscreen",
            "post",
            format,
            None,
            false,
        );
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let filter_configs = [[1, 0, 5, 0], [0, 1, 5, 0]].map(|axis| {
            buffer(
                &device,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&Filter {
                    axis,
                    values: [9., 0.01, 0., 0.],
                }),
                wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM,
            )
        });
        let ui = controls::Panel::new(&window, &device, format);
        let mut s = Self {
            ui,
            window,
            surface,
            device,
            queue,
            config,
            particles,
            camera,
            post_config,
            _palette: palette,
            sampler,
            filter_configs,
            depth_pipeline,
            pigment_pipeline,
            filter_pipeline,
            light_pipeline,
            post_pipeline,
            splats,
            targets: None,
            yaw: 0.,
            pitch: 0.15,
            distance: 5.,
            scene_scale: 10.,
            capacity,
        };
        s.resize(size.width, size.height);
        Ok(s)
    }
    fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
        if width == 0 || height == 0 {
            return;
        }
        self.config.width = width;
        self.config.height = height;
        self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
        let tex = |format, usage| {
            self.device
                .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
                    label: None,
                    size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                        width,
                        height,
                        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
                    },
                    mip_level_count: 1,
                    sample_count: 1,
                    dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
                    format,
                    usage,
                    view_formats: &[],
                })
                .create_view(&Default::default())
        };
        let usage = wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING;
        let depth: Vec<_> = (0..3)
            .map(|_| tex(wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float, usage))
            .collect();
        let pigment: Vec<_> = (0..3)
            .map(|_| tex(wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float, usage))
            .collect();
        let hardware = tex(
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
            wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
        );
        let hdr = tex(
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        );
        let filters = (0..2)
            .map(|i| {
                group(
                    &self.device,
                    &self.filter_pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0),
                    &[
                        wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&depth[i]),
                        wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&pigment[i]),
                        wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&depth[i + 1]),
                        wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&pigment[i + 1]),
                        self.filter_configs[i].as_entire_binding(),
                    ],
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let lighting = group(
            &self.device,
            &self.light_pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            &[
                wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&depth[2]),
                wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&pigment[2]),
                self.camera.as_entire_binding(),
            ],
        );
        let post = group(
            &self.device,
            &self.post_pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            &[
                wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&hdr),
                wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&depth[2]),
                wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
                self.post_config.as_entire_binding(),
            ],
        );
        self.targets = Some(Targets {
            depth,
            pigment,
            hardware,
            hdr,
            filters,
            lighting,
            post,
        });
    }
    fn draw(&mut self, u: &mut Universe, paused: &mut bool) -> Result<()> {
        let output_ui = self.ui.frame(&self.window, u, paused);
        if let Some(model) = &u.fusion {
            self.scene_scale = model.settings.half_extent.into_iter().fold(0., f32::max);
            self.queue
                .write_buffer(&self._palette, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&model.palette));
        }
        ensure!(
            u.particles.len() <= self.capacity,
            "renderer particle capacity exceeded"
        );
        let rows: Vec<_> = (0..u.particles.len())
            .map(|i| {
                let p = u.particles.get(i);
                RenderParticle {
                    p: [
                        p.pos_rad[0] / self.scene_scale,
                        p.pos_rad[1] / self.scene_scale,
                        p.pos_rad[2] / self.scene_scale,
                        p.phenotype[0] as f32,
                    ],
                    v: p.vel_mass,
                    previous: [0.; 4],
                }
            })
            .collect();
        self.queue
            .write_buffer(&self.particles, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&rows));
        let f = [
            -self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.cos(),
            -self.pitch.sin(),
            -self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.cos(),
        ];
        let right = [self.yaw.cos(), 0., -self.yaw.sin()];
        let up = [
            -self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.sin(),
            self.pitch.cos(),
            -self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.sin(),
        ];
        let camera: [[f32; 4]; 8] = [
            [
                -f[0] * self.distance,
                -f[1] * self.distance,
                -f[2] * self.distance,
                0.,
            ],
            [right[0], right[1], right[2], 0.],
            [up[0], up[1], up[2], 0.],
            [f[0], f[1], f[2], 0.5],
            [
                self.config.width as f32,
                self.config.height as f32,
                self.ui.presentation.radius,
                0.,
            ],
            [self.ui.presentation.roughness, 4., 0.2, 450.],
            [0., 0., 0.25, 0.25],
            [0.; 4],
        ];
        self.queue
            .write_buffer(&self.camera, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&camera));
        let post: [[f32; 4]; 3] = [
            [
                self.config.width as f32,
                self.config.height as f32,
                u.tick as f32,
                0.,
            ],
            [self.distance, 0.8, 0.15, self.ui.presentation.exposure],
            [
                0.25,
                0.002,
                if self.config.format.is_srgb() { 1. } else { 0. },
                0.,
            ],
        ];
        self.queue
            .write_buffer(&self.post_config, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&post));
        let output = match self.surface.get_current_texture() {
            Ok(x) => x,
            Err(wgpu::SurfaceError::Lost | wgpu::SurfaceError::Outdated) => {
                self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
                return Ok(());
            }
            Err(wgpu::SurfaceError::Timeout) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),
        };
        let view = output.texture.create_view(&Default::default());
        let t = self.targets.as_ref().unwrap();
        let mut encoder = self.device.create_command_encoder(&Default::default());
        fn render(
            encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
            target: &wgpu::TextureView,
            clear: wgpu::Color,
            hardware: Option<&wgpu::TextureView>,
            pipeline: &wgpu::RenderPipeline,
            bind: &wgpu::BindGroup,
            vertices: u32,
            instances: u32,
        ) {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: None,
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: target,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(clear),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: hardware.map(|view| {
                    wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                        view,
                        depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        }),
                        stencil_ops: None,
                    }
                }),
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, bind, &[]);
            pass.draw(0..vertices, 0..instances);
        }
        render(
            &mut encoder,
            &t.depth[0],
            wgpu::Color {
                r: 10.,
                g: 0.,
                b: 0.,
                a: 0.,
            },
            Some(&t.hardware),
            &self.depth_pipeline,
            &self.splats,
            6,
            rows.len() as u32,
        );
        render(
            &mut encoder,
            &t.pigment[0],
            wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT,
            None,
            &self.pigment_pipeline,
            &self.splats,
            6,
            rows.len() as u32,
        );
        for bind in &t.filters {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("bilateral"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.filter_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, bind, &[]);
            pass.dispatch_workgroups(
                self.config.width.div_ceil(8),
                self.config.height.div_ceil(8),
                1,
            );
        }
        render(
            &mut encoder,
            &t.hdr,
            wgpu::Color::BLACK,
            None,
            &self.light_pipeline,
            &t.lighting,
            3,
            1,
        );
        render(
            &mut encoder,
            &view,
            wgpu::Color::BLACK,
            None,
            &self.post_pipeline,
            &t.post,
            3,
            1,
        );
        let prepared = self.ui.prepare(
            &self.device,
            &self.queue,
            &mut encoder,
            output_ui,
            [self.config.width, self.config.height],
        );
        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("NOVA native inspector"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
            self.ui.paint(&mut pass, &prepared);
        }
        self.ui.finish(&prepared);
        self.queue
            .submit(prepared.commands.into_iter().chain([encoder.finish()]));
        output.present();
        Ok(())
    }
}
/// Space pauses, arrows orbit, wheel zooms, E injects a jet, Escape exits.
pub fn run(mut universe: Universe, gpu: bool, output: Option<PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {
    let event_loop = EventLoop::new()?;
    let window = Arc::new(
        WindowBuilder::new()
            .with_title("NOVA native · space: pause · arrows: orbit · wheel: zoom · E: emit")
            .with_inner_size(winit::dpi::LogicalSize::new(1280, 800))
            .build(&event_loop)?,
    );
    let mut renderer = pollster::block_on(Renderer::new(window, universe.config.max_particles))?;
    if let Some(model) = &universe.fusion {
        renderer.scene_scale = model.settings.half_extent.into_iter().fold(0., f32::max);
        renderer.pitch = if model.settings.dimensions == 2 {
            0.
        } else {
            0.15
        };
        renderer
            .queue
            .write_buffer(&renderer._palette, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&model.palette));
    }
    let compute = if gpu {
        Some(nova_gpu::Gpu::new()?)
    } else {
        None
    };
    let lake = Rc::new(RefCell::new(
        output
            .map(|p| Lake::new(p, &universe, 24, 32.))
            .transpose()?,
    ));
    let recorder = lake.clone();
    let error = Rc::new(RefCell::new(None::<String>));
    let failures = error.clone();
    let mut paused = false;
    let mut children = Vec::<nova_physics::FusionCandidate>::new();
    let mut last_title = Instant::now();
    let mut frames = 0;
    let mut pointer = [0f64; 2];
    let mut radial = 0f32;
    event_loop.run(move |event, elwt| {
        elwt.set_control_flow(ControlFlow::WaitUntil(
            Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(16),
        ));
        let result: Result<()> = (|| {
            if let Event::WindowEvent { event, .. } = &event {
                if renderer.ui.on_event(&renderer.window, event) {
                    radial = 0.;
                    return Ok(());
                }
            }
            match event {
                Event::WindowEvent { event, .. } => match event {
                    WindowEvent::CloseRequested => elwt.exit(),
                    WindowEvent::Resized(size) => renderer.resize(size.width, size.height),
                    WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, .. }
                        if event.state == ElementState::Pressed =>
                    {
                        match event.physical_key {
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::Escape) => elwt.exit(),
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::Space) => paused = !paused,
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::ArrowLeft) => renderer.yaw -= 0.1,
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::ArrowRight) => renderer.yaw += 0.1,
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::ArrowUp) => {
                                renderer.pitch = (renderer.pitch + 0.1).min(1.4)
                            }
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::ArrowDown) => {
                                renderer.pitch = (renderer.pitch - 0.1).max(-1.4)
                            }
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyE)
                                if !universe.config.mpm && universe.fusion.is_none() =>
                            {
                                let room = universe.config.max_particles - universe.particles.len();
                                universe.emit(room.min(256))?;
                            }
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyB) if universe.fusion.is_some() => {
                                children = universe.breed_rules()?;
                            }
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyM) if universe.fusion.is_some() => {
                                let choices = universe.breed_rules()?;
                                universe.choose_rules(&choices[2])?;
                            }
                            PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyR) if universe.fusion.is_some() => {
                                let choices = universe.breed_rules()?;
                                universe.choose_rules(&choices[5])?;
                            }
                            PhysicalKey::Code(code) if !children.is_empty() => {
                                let i = match code {
                                    KeyCode::Digit1 => Some(0),
                                    KeyCode::Digit2 => Some(1),
                                    KeyCode::Digit3 => Some(2),
                                    KeyCode::Digit4 => Some(3),
                                    KeyCode::Digit5 => Some(4),
                                    KeyCode::Digit6 => Some(5),
                                    _ => None,
                                };
                                if let Some(i) = i {
                                    universe.choose_rules(&children[i])?;
                                    children.clear();
                                }
                            }
                            _ => (),
                        }
                    }
                    WindowEvent::CursorMoved { position, .. } => {
                        pointer = [position.x, position.y];
                    }
                    WindowEvent::MouseInput { state, button, .. } => {
                        if matches!(
                            button,
                            winit::event::MouseButton::Left | winit::event::MouseButton::Right
                        ) {
                            radial = if state == ElementState::Released {
                                0.
                            } else if button == winit::event::MouseButton::Left {
                                1.
                            } else {
                                -1.
                            };
                        }
                    }
                    WindowEvent::MouseWheel { delta, .. } => {
                        let amount = match delta {
                            MouseScrollDelta::LineDelta(_, y) => y,
                            MouseScrollDelta::PixelDelta(p) => p.y as f32 * 0.02,
                        };
                        renderer.distance = (renderer.distance - amount * 0.2).clamp(1., 8.);
                    }
                    WindowEvent::RedrawRequested => {
                        if renderer.window.inner_size().width == 0
                            || renderer.window.inner_size().height == 0
                        {
                            return Ok(());
                        }
                        if !paused || renderer.ui.single_step {
                            renderer.ui.single_step = false;
                            if radial != 0. {
                                if let Some(model) = &mut universe.fusion {
                                    let aspect = renderer.config.width as f32
                                        / renderer.config.height as f32;
                                    let x = (pointer[0] as f32 / renderer.config.width as f32 * 2.
                                        - 1.)
                                        * 0.5
                                        * renderer.distance
                                        * aspect
                                        * renderer.scene_scale;
                                    let y = (1.
                                        - pointer[1] as f32 / renderer.config.height as f32 * 2.)
                                        * 0.5
                                        * renderer.distance
                                        * renderer.scene_scale;
                                    model.set_brush(
                                        [x, y, 0.],
                                        model.settings.cutoff() * 2.,
                                        radial * model.settings.force * 4.,
                                    )?;
                                }
                            }
                            if let Some(gpu) = &compute {
                                gpu.step(&mut universe)?;
                            } else {
                                universe.step(1)?;
                            }
                            if universe.tick % 10 == 0 {
                                if let Some(lake) = recorder.borrow_mut().as_mut() {
                                    lake.record(&universe, true)?;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        renderer.draw(&mut universe, &mut paused)?;
                        frames += 1;
                        if last_title.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(1) {
                            renderer.window.set_title(&format!(
                                "NOVA · {} particles · {} births · {:0.1} FPS · {}",
                                universe.particles.len(),
                                universe.births,
                                frames as f64 / last_title.elapsed().as_secs_f64(),
                                if paused { "paused" } else { "running" }
                            ));
                            frames = 0;
                            last_title = Instant::now();
                        }
                    }
                    _ => (),
                },
                Event::AboutToWait => renderer.window.request_redraw(),
                _ => (),
            }
            Ok(())
        })();
        if let Err(e) = result {
            *failures.borrow_mut() = Some(format!("{e:#}"));
            elwt.exit();
        }
    })?;
    if let Some(lake) = lake.borrow_mut().take() {
        lake.finish()?;
    }
    if let Some(e) = error.borrow_mut().take() {
        anyhow::bail!(e);
    }
    Ok(())
}

//! Finite observations and candidate equations, never automatic physical theorems.
use anyhow::{ensure, Result};
use nova_core::Particles;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Observables {
    pub mass: f64,
    pub kinetic: f64,
    pub momentum: [f64; 3],
    pub angular_momentum: [f64; 3],
    pub metabolic_energy: u64,
}
pub fn observe(p: &Particles) -> Observables {
    let mut o = Observables {
        mass: 0.,
        kinetic: 0.,
        momentum: [0.; 3],
        angular_momentum: [0.; 3],
        metabolic_energy: 0,
    };
    for i in 0..p.len() {
        let x = p.positions[i].0;
        let v = p.velocities[i].0;
        let m = v[3] as f64;
        o.mass += m;
        o.metabolic_energy += p.phenotypes[i][3] as u64;
        for k in 0..3 {
            o.kinetic += 0.5 * m * (v[k] as f64).powi(2);
            o.momentum[k] += m * v[k] as f64;
            o.angular_momentum[k] += m
                * (x[(k + 1) % 3] as f64 * v[(k + 2) % 3] as f64
                    - x[(k + 2) % 3] as f64 * v[(k + 1) % 3] as f64);
        }
    }
    o
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct Relevance {
    pub normalized_entropy: f64,
    pub occupied_cells: usize,
    pub h0_lifetimes: Vec<f32>,
    pub persistent_components: usize,
    pub accepted: bool,
    pub topology_scope: &'static str,
}
/// Exact H0 Vietoris-Rips death times on a stable, at-most-64-particle subsample.
/// Kruskal MST, not a claim to H1/H2 persistent homology of the full universe.
pub fn relevance(p: &Particles) -> Relevance {
    let mut bins = HashMap::new();
    for x in &p.positions {
        *bins
            .entry([
                (x.0[0] / 0.5).floor() as i32,
                (x.0[1] / 0.5).floor() as i32,
                (x.0[2] / 0.5).floor() as i32,
            ])
            .or_insert(0usize) += 1;
    }
    let entropy = bins
        .values()
        .map(|&n| {
            let q = n as f64 / p.len().max(1) as f64;
            -q * q.ln()
        })
        .sum::<f64>()
        / (p.len().max(2) as f64).ln();
    let mut order: Vec<_> = (0..p.len()).collect();
    order.sort_unstable_by_key(|&i| p.ids[i]);
    order.truncate(64);
    let mut edges = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..order.len() {
        for j in i + 1..order.len() {
            edges.push((
                nova_core::norm(nova_core::delta(
                    p.positions[order[i]].0,
                    p.positions[order[j]].0,
                )),
                i,
                j,
            ));
        }
    }
    edges.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
    let mut roots: Vec<_> = (0..order.len()).collect();
    fn root(r: &[usize], mut i: usize) -> usize {
        while r[i] != i {
            i = r[i];
        }
        i
    }
    let mut lifetimes = Vec::new();
    for (d, i, j) in edges {
        let a = root(&roots, i);
        let b = root(&roots, j);
        if a != b {
            roots[a] = b;
            lifetimes.push(d);
        }
    }
    let persistent = lifetimes.iter().filter(|&&x| x > 0.5 && x < 8.).count();
    Relevance {
        normalized_entropy: entropy,
        occupied_cells: bins.len(),
        persistent_components: persistent,
        accepted: p.len() > 1 && entropy > 0.05 && entropy < 0.98 && persistent > 0,
        h0_lifetimes: lifetimes,
        topology_scope: "H0 on <=64 stable IDs; no H1/H2 or scientific relevance guarantee",
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct Candidate {
    pub equation: String,
    pub coefficients: Vec<f64>,
    pub residual_rmse: f64,
    pub samples: usize,
    pub status: &'static str,
}
/// L1 coordinate descent on [1,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz], standardized by column RMS.
pub fn sparse_fit(x: &[[f64; 7]], y: &[f64], lambda: f64) -> Result<Candidate> {
    ensure!(
        !x.is_empty()
            && x.len() == y.len()
            && x.iter().flatten().chain(y).all(|v| v.is_finite())
            && lambda >= 0.
            && lambda.is_finite(),
        "invalid regression data"
    );
    let n = x.len() as f64;
    let mut scale = [1.; 7];
    for j in 0..7 {
        scale[j] = (x.iter().map(|r| r[j] * r[j]).sum::<f64>() / n)
            .sqrt()
            .max(1e-10);
    }
    let mut coefficients = [0.; 7];
    let mut residual = y.to_vec();
    for _ in 0..200 {
        for j in 0..7 {
            let old = coefficients[j];
            let rho = x
                .iter()
                .zip(&residual)
                .map(|(r, &v)| {
                    let a = r[j] / scale[j];
                    a * (v + a * old)
                })
                .sum::<f64>()
                / n;
            let denom = x.iter().map(|r| (r[j] / scale[j]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>() / n;
            let value = if j == 0 {
                rho
            } else {
                rho.signum() * (rho.abs() - lambda).max(0.)
            } / denom.max(1e-12);
            for (r, v) in x.iter().zip(&mut residual) {
                *v += (old - value) * r[j] / scale[j];
            }
            coefficients[j] = value;
        }
    }
    let coefficients: Vec<_> = coefficients.iter().zip(scale).map(|(c, s)| c / s).collect();
    let labels = ["1", "x", "y", "z", "vx", "vy", "vz"];
    let equation = coefficients
        .iter()
        .zip(labels)
        .filter(|(c, _)| c.abs() > 1e-9)
        .map(|(c, l)| format!("({c:0.9})*{l}"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" + ");
    Ok(Candidate {
        equation: format!("ax = {}", if equation.is_empty() { "0" } else { &equation }),
        coefficients,
        residual_rmse: (residual.iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f64>() / n).sqrt(),
        samples: x.len(),
        status: "candidate_not_verified",
    })
}
/// Lie derivative of I along f estimated by a centered directional difference.
pub fn lie_derivative(
    state: &[f64],
    field: &[f64],
    epsilon: f64,
    invariant: impl Fn(&[f64]) -> f64,
) -> Result<f64> {
    ensure!(
        state.len() == field.len()
            && epsilon.is_finite()
            && epsilon > 0.
            && state.iter().chain(field).all(|x| x.is_finite()),
        "invalid Lie audit input"
    );
    let plus: Vec<_> = state
        .iter()
        .zip(field)
        .map(|(x, f)| x + epsilon * f)
        .collect();
    let minus: Vec<_> = state
        .iter()
        .zip(field)
        .map(|(x, f)| x - epsilon * f)
        .collect();
    Ok((invariant(&plus) - invariant(&minus)) / (2. * epsilon))
}
pub fn lean_template() -> &'static str {
    r#"import Mathlib
-- This is an algebraic pair-impulse identity, not a proof of a simulated law.
-- Receipt remains pending until `lake env lean PairMomentum.lean` succeeds.
theorem pair_impulse_momentum (ma mb va vb impulse : ℝ)
    (ha : ma ≠ 0) (hb : mb ≠ 0) :
    ma * (va + impulse / ma) + mb * (vb - impulse / mb) = ma * va + mb * vb := by
  field_simp
  <;> ring
"#
}
